newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Nokia said upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Nokia said upgraded to buy.

text.p: --SBC Warburg upgraded Finnish telecom Nokia to buy from sell, a source at the firm in New York said Tuesday.
--Based on its valuation analysis, the firm believes Nokia's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) could reach $47 within the next six months, the source said.

--"We think they are one of the better positioned companies in the cellular business. They now have worked down their excess inventories and are on track to see a recovery in their mobile phone division margins," the source said.
--Nokia's ADRs were off 3/8 at 41-1/2 in early trade.
